title: Simple Epidemic Simulation
description: Models the spread of a virus in a population of 1000 people.

interactions.name: Virus Transmission
interactions.description: An Infected person interacting with a Susceptible person can lead to the Susceptible person becoming Infected.

metrics.name: Infected Count
metrics.description: The number of individuals currently in the Infected state over time.

metrics.name: Recovered Count
metrics.description: The number of individuals currently in the Recovered state over time.

metrics.name: Total Infections
metrics.description: The cumulative number of individuals who have transitioned into the Infected state.

validation_criteria.name: Population Conservation
validation_criteria.description: The sum of Susceptible, Infected, and Recovered counts at any point in time must equal the initial population size.

validation_criteria.name: Epidemic Curve Shape
validation_criteria.description: The 'Infected Count' metric should typically show an initial rise and subsequent fall, characteristic of epidemic models, influenced by parameters.

validation_criteria.name: Parameter Sensitivity
validation_criteria.description: Changes in key parameters (e.g., transmission_probability, recovery_time_steps) should result in expected changes in the simulation dynamics (e.g., faster/slower spread, higher/lower peak infections).
